A '''shipsuit''', manufactured by [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]], was a multipocketed [[Jumpsuit/Legends|coverall]] made of a tough [[Synthmesh/Legends|synthmesh]] fabric that could last through [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of regular use. They had many pockets for carrying tools and equipment. Shipsuits were fireproof, although wearers could still be harmed and killed by raw heat, and electrically non-conductive. Fitted shipsuits could be used as the internal body sleeve for a [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]], allowing the wearer to change into EVA equipment quickly.<ref name="PP" />

During the [[Bakura Incident]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] personnel, including [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tessa Manchisco]], and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] wore [[Color/Legends|white-]], cream-, or gray-colored shipsuits while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>
